abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we propose FFDP, a set of IO-aware non-GEMM fused kernels supplemented with a distributed framework for image registration at unprecedented scales.
Image registration is an inverse problem fundamental to biomedical and life sciences, but algorithms have not scaled in tandem with image acquisition capabilities.
abstract_sentences.link_to_previous: explains the application gap motivating FFDP

abstract_sentences.text: Our framework complements existing model parallelism techniques proposed for large-scale transformer training by optimizing non-GEMM bottlenecks and enabling convolution-aware tensor sharding.
abstract_sentences.link_to_previous: states the transfer from GEMM-oriented scaling to registration

abstract_sentences.text: We demonstrate unprecedented capabilities by performing multimodal registration of a 100µm ex-vivo human brain MRI volume at native resolution – an inverse problem more than 570× larger than a standard clinical datum in about a minute using only 8 A6000 GPUs.
abstract_sentences.comparison: problem size versus a standard clinical datum
abstract_sentences.link_to_previous: instantiates the proposed scaling mechanism on the headline case

abstract_sentences.text: FFDP accelerates existing state-of-the-art optimization and deep learning registration pipelines by upto 6 − 7× while reducing peak memory consumption by 20 − 59%.
abstract_sentences.link_to_previous: broadens the case-study capability into workflow acceleration

abstract_sentences.text: Comparative analysis on a 250µm dataset shows that FFDP can fit upto 64× larger problems than existing SOTA on a single GPU, and highlights both the performance and efficiency gains of FFDP compared to SOTA image registration methods.
abstract_sentences.link_to_previous: closes with the broad comparative claim

abstract_function_summary.reported_results: 100µm native-resolution registration; >570× clinical scale; about one minute on 8 A6000 GPUs; 6–7× acceleration; 20–59% peak-memory reduction; up to 64× larger single-GPU fit.
abstract_function_summary.strongest_claim_position: 第 4 句先给出 headline capability，第 6 句以 64× single-GPU fit 收束；摘要后半部集中最强主张。

evidence.anchor: about a minute using only 8 A6000 GPUs

method_component_map.problem: identity/affine/composite grids materialize up to 9N HBM overhead and complicate shard coordinates
method_component_map.mechanism: 由 xbounds 隐式生成坐标，在 fused CUDA kernel 内完成 Ax+t+Su(x) 与 sampling
method_component_map.prediction: extra grid HBM 从 O(N) 降为 O(1)，并可直接适配 sharded coordinate bounds

method_component_map.problem: MI 需要 B×N Parzen blocks，典型 clinical volume 可占 7.5GB HBM
method_component_map.mechanism: 在 shared memory 中逐像素累计 histogram 与 partial gradients，不 materialize ΨI/ΨJ
method_component_map.prediction: 固定 B 时 additional HBM 为 O(1)

method_component_map.problem: LNCC forward/backward 保存大量 intermediate tensors
method_component_map.mechanism: fuse intermediates，backward 原位改写 saved intermediates
method_component_map.prediction: 保存 5× intermediates，正文报告内存最多下降 76.5%

evidence.anchor: computed by modifying the saved intermediates in-place

method_component_map.problem: generic tensor/model parallelism 不同步 convolution boundaries
method_component_map.mechanism: tensor metadata 保存 sharded dimension/bounds，并在 convolution 前同步 halo
method_component_map.prediction: fixed image、warp 与 optimizer state 均可分片且保持 boundary correctness

method_component_map.problem: warp 的 random access 可指向任意 moving-image shard，allgather 会限制最大问题规模
method_component_map.mechanism: image shards 沿 ring 传送，每台 host 原位累计 interpolation partial sums
method_component_map.prediction: fetch overhead 为 N/H，而非每 GPU 保留完整 N

evidence.anchor: sent across hosts in a ring topology

method_component_map.problem: loss 的 per-pixel、patch 与 histogram aggregate 跨 shard 语义不同
method_component_map.mechanism: MSE allreduce；LNCC halo 后 allreduce；MI 对 per-host histogram 做 Nh/N 加权 allreduce
method_component_map.prediction: MI communication overhead 为 B²+2B，与 N 无关

claim_closure.claim: IO-aware non-GEMM primitives reduce memory and accelerate existing registration pipelines.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 单一主线是：高分辨率 registration 的瓶颈来自 non-GEMM intermediate HBM 与 convolution/random-access sharding；FFDP 先以 fused implicit kernels 消除单 GPU intermediate，再以 GP halo 与 Ring Sampler partial sums 扩展到多 GPU。[PDF p. 4, §3.1, explicit, ‘avoids materializing any additional grids’; p. 6, §4.2, explicit, ‘aggregate of partial sums’]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (1)–(2)、六个关键组件的机制、Figures 1–8、Table 1、100µm/58-second capability、Faux-OASIS metrics 和 Ring/GP ablations，足以让读者判断系统主张与主要 tradeoff。[PDF p. 8, §5.2, explicit, ‘took ∼58 seconds’; p. 10, §5.4, explicit, ‘independent of H’]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 推导、pseudocode、dataset construction、hyperparameters、profiling 与扩展 ablations 被调用到 Sections A/D–K、Tables 3–4、Figures 9–20；这些文件不在 supplied PDF，因此正文对 correctness 与 reproducibility 不完全自足。[PDF p. 4, §3.1, explicit, ‘pseudocode ... Section H’; p. 9, §5.3, explicit, ‘more details in Section K’]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是 problem-specific memory accounting → fused/distributed mechanism → asymptotic prediction → matched ablation：例如 Ring Sampler 从 full-image replication 推出 N/H overhead，再用 Figure 8a 检验 per-GPU memory 是否随 H 增长。[PDF p. 7, §4.2, explicit, ‘additional N/H HBM overhead’; p. 10, §5.4, explicit, ‘independent of H’]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口是 real 100µm capability 与 real-case accuracy 未闭合：系统确实运行并给出 qualitative slices，但 fiducials 私有；量化准确性依赖 simulated Faux-OASIS。另有 11.8B/11.2B 与 Section 5.3 comparator 不明的数字不一致。[PDF p. 9, §5.2, explicit, ‘privately annotated fiducial markers’; p. 9, §5.3, explicit, ‘synthesize the faux-OASIS dataset’]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 可迁移规则：系统论文把每个 scale claim 写成一条可证伪链——先量化 materialized state，再给 local/distributed decomposition 与 asymptotic cost，最后用 matched component-off ablation 验证资源曲线和 correctness artifact。[PDF p. 4, §3.1, explicit, ‘costing a total of 9N’; p. 10, §5.4, explicit, ‘replacing it with DTensor sharding’]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合瓶颈可由 state/communication 分解且能做 matched ablation 的系统；它不替代真实任务有效性验证。此文的 100µm 案例说明 throughput closure 与 biomedical accuracy closure 必须分开。[PDF p. 8, §5.2, explicit, ‘∼58 seconds’; p. 9, §5.2, explicit, ‘hindering reproducibility’]
